CORNER Skills Catalog: C3/C4 Launch

Author: Steve (AI Advisory Lead) Date: 2026-03-16 For: Bobby (build), Elon (infrastructure), Patrik (sales), Steffen (skill card UI design) Purpose: Define every skill that exists on day one when a client opens their Corner office. These are the building blocks. Each skill is a repeatable workflow that an agent can execute.

How Skills Work in Corner

A skill is a documented workflow that an agent follows when triggered. Skills live in .claude/skills/[skill-name]/SKILL.md. When a user says "schedule a call with John next Tuesday" the Calendar skill activates. When they say "draft a follow-up email to the client" the Email Drafter skill activates.

Skills are the product. More skills = more value. The catalog grows over time. Clients at higher tiers get access to more skills.

Skill Tiers

Tier Skills Available Price
Starter Core (14 skills) $1,500/month
Growth Core + Growth (24 skills) $3,000/month
Scale Core + Growth + Scale (32 skills) $5,000/month
Enterprise All + Custom builds $10,000+/month

Core Skills (All Tiers, 14 Skills)

These ship with every Corner instance. The basics that every business needs.

1. Calendar Management

Trigger: "Schedule...", "Book...", "What's on my calendar...", "Move my meeting..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Create, update, delete calendar events via natural language
  • Check availability and suggest times
  • Handle timezone conversion
  • Send meeting invitations
  • Daily morning briefing of the day's schedule
  • Conflict detection and resolution Integration: Google Calendar API, Outlook Calendar API AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/calendar/

2. Email Drafter

Trigger: "Draft an email to...", "Reply to...", "Follow up with..." Agent: Communications What it does:

  • Draft emails in the client's voice (learned from examples during onboarding)
  • Reply suggestions for incoming emails
  • Follow-up reminders when emails go unanswered for X days
  • Bulk personalized emails (up to 10/batch in Core)
  • Auto-categorize incoming emails by priority Integration: Gmail API, Outlook API AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/email-drafter/

3. Task Management

Trigger: "Add a task...", "What's on my list...", "Mark [X] done..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Create, update, complete tasks via natural language
  • Drag-to-reorder in Checklist mode
  • Auto-assign to agents based on task type
  • Due date tracking and reminders
  • Weekly task summary Integration: Native (Corner's own task system in Supabase) AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/punch-list/

4. Client Follow-Up

Trigger: "Follow up with [client]", auto-triggered on configurable intervals Agent: Communications What it does:

  • Track last contact date per client
  • Auto-draft follow-up messages when contact lapses beyond threshold (configurable: 7/14/30 days)
  • Personalized follow-up based on last interaction context
  • Flag clients at risk of churning (no contact > 30 days) Integration: Email API, CRM (when available) AOM internal equivalent: Part of outreach + Paige's client health tracking

5. Daily Briefing

Trigger: Auto-triggered every morning (configurable time), or "What's going on today?" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Summary of today's calendar
  • Overdue tasks
  • Pending follow-ups
  • Key metrics snapshot (if connected)
  • Weather and commute (if location-enabled)
  • Delivered via dashboard notification + optional email Integration: Calendar, Tasks, Email (read) AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/plan-my-day/

6. Meeting Notes

Trigger: "Summarize my meeting", "Take notes on..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Accept pasted transcript or audio file (via Whisper API)
  • Extract: key decisions, action items, owners, deadlines
  • Format as clean summary document
  • Auto-create tasks for each action item
  • Store in client's document library Integration: Whisper API (audio), native document storage

7. Quick Research

Trigger: "Look up...", "What is...", "Find info on..." Agent: Research What it does:

  • Web search and summarize results
  • Company lookup (basic public info)
  • Industry data queries
  • Competitor monitoring (basic)
  • Answer factual questions with source links Integration: Web search API AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/look/

8. Document Generator

Trigger: "Create a proposal for...", "Draft a report on...", "Generate an invoice..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Generate proposals from templates (configured during onboarding)
  • Create invoices from project/client data
  • Draft reports with sections and formatting
  • Standard letter generation
  • Export as PDF Integration: Native document system, PDF generation

9. Contact Management

Trigger: "Add [name] as a contact...", "What's [name]'s email?", "Show me all contacts at [company]" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Store and retrieve contact information
  • Link contacts to companies
  • Track interaction history (auto-logged from emails and calendar)
  • Tag and categorize contacts
  • Search by any field Integration: Native (Supabase contacts table), Email API (auto-populate)

10. Expense Tracking (Basic)

Trigger: "Log an expense...", "What did I spend this month on..." Agent: Finance What it does:

  • Manual expense entry via natural language ("spent $450 on materials at Home Depot today")
  • Categorize expenses (materials, labor, fuel, food, tools, office)
  • Monthly summary by category
  • Export as CSV for CPA
  • Receipt photo storage (upload via dashboard) Integration: Native (Supabase), file upload

11. Reminder System

Trigger: "Remind me to...", "Don't let me forget..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Time-based reminders (specific date/time, relative: "in 2 hours", "next Monday")
  • Recurring reminders ("every Friday at 3 PM: review timesheets")
  • Location-based reminders (future: when near [address]) -- C5
  • Delivery: dashboard notification + optional email/SMS Integration: Native scheduling system

12. Internal Knowledge Base

Trigger: "How do we handle...", "What's our process for...", "SOP for..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Store company SOPs, processes, policies
  • Answer questions from the knowledge base
  • Suggest updates when processes change
  • New employee onboarding: "Ask me anything about how we do things" Integration: Native document system (client's context files)

13. Weather and Conditions

Trigger: "What's the weather...", auto-included in daily briefing Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Current conditions and forecast for client's location
  • Construction-specific: wind speed, precipitation probability, UV index
  • Schedule impact alerts ("rain expected tomorrow, 2 outdoor jobs may need rescheduling") Integration: Weather API (OpenWeather or similar)

14. Status Report

Trigger: "Give me a status report", "What's everyone working on?" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Snapshot of all agents and their current tasks
  • Completed work since last report
  • Blockers and pending items
  • Health indicators (all green, warnings, critical)
  • Configurable frequency: daily, weekly, on-demand Integration: Native (reads agent states) AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/status/

Growth Skills (Growth Tier and Above, 10 Additional Skills)

These unlock at the Growth tier ($3,000/month). More automation, more intelligence.

15. Social Media Drafter

Trigger: "Draft a post about...", "Create content for [platform]..." Agent: Content What it does:

  • Draft posts for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook
  • Adapt tone per platform (professional for LinkedIn, visual for IG)
  • Suggest posting schedule based on engagement data
  • Before/after photo posts for construction (with image upload)
  • Hashtag research and recommendations
  • Queue posts for review before publishing Integration: Native drafting (manual posting by client until Postiz integration in C5) AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/social-agent/ + .claude/skills/doc-social-edit/

16. Lead Pipeline Tracker

Trigger: "New lead from...", "Move [company] to proposal stage", "Show me my pipeline" Agent: Sales What it does:

  • Simple Kanban pipeline: Lead > Contacted > Proposal > Negotiation > Won/Lost
  • Auto-move based on email interactions (replied = Contacted, proposal sent = Proposal)
  • Pipeline value calculation
  • Stale lead alerts (no activity > 7 days)
  • Weekly pipeline summary Integration: Native (Supabase pipeline tables), Email API

17. Estimate/Quote Generator

Trigger: "Create an estimate for...", "Quote [project type] for [client]" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Generate estimates from templates (configured per business type)
  • Line items with quantities, rates, and totals
  • Material cost lookup (manual entry, auto-calculate)
  • Markup and margin calculations
  • Export as branded PDF
  • Track estimate status (sent, viewed, accepted, declined) Integration: Native, PDF generation Construction-specific: Pre-built templates for HVAC install, plumbing repair, electrical panel upgrade, general remodel

18. Automated Outreach

Trigger: "Start outreach to [list]", "Send follow-up sequence to..." Agent: Outreach What it does:

  • Multi-step email sequences (up to 3 emails, configurable delays)
  • Personalization from contact data (first name, company, industry)
  • Open/reply tracking
  • Auto-stop sequence when prospect replies
  • Performance reporting (open rate, reply rate, conversion)
  • Batch limit: 25 contacts per sequence Integration: Email API, dedicated sending domain AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/outreach/

19. Client Health Monitor

Trigger: Auto-runs weekly, or "How's [client] doing?" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Score each active client: Green (healthy), Yellow (watch), Orange (at risk), Red (critical)
  • Factors: last contact date, payment status, project status, communication frequency
  • Alert on status changes
  • Recommended actions per status level
  • Monthly health report Integration: Native (reads from contacts, calendar, email, tasks) AOM internal equivalent: Paige's health scans

20. Scheduling Dispatch

Trigger: "Assign [job] to [crew/person]", "What's [person]'s schedule this week?" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Crew/employee schedule management
  • Job assignment based on availability, skills, location
  • Route optimization suggestions (group nearby jobs)
  • Schedule conflict detection
  • Client notification when crew is en route (manual trigger)
  • Daily dispatch sheet generation Integration: Calendar API, native scheduling Construction-specific: Built for field crew management

21. Invoice and Payment Tracking

Trigger: "Invoice [client] for...", "Who hasn't paid?", "Send a payment reminder..." Agent: Finance What it does:

  • Generate invoices from estimates or manual entry
  • Track payment status (sent, viewed, paid, overdue)
  • Automatic payment reminders at configurable intervals (7, 14, 30 days overdue)
  • Monthly accounts receivable summary
  • Export for CPA/bookkeeper Integration: Native, PDF generation, email for reminders. Stripe integration in C5.

22. Project Timeline

Trigger: "Create a timeline for [project]", "When does [phase] start?" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Simple Gantt-style timeline from natural language ("Phase 1 starts March 20, takes 2 weeks, Phase 2 follows immediately")
  • Milestone tracking
  • Dependency awareness (Phase 2 can't start until Phase 1 ends)
  • Auto-update when delays occur
  • Client-facing timeline export (PDF) Integration: Native

23. Review Request Automation

Trigger: Auto-triggered after project completion, or "Ask [client] for a review" Agent: Communications What it does:

  • Send review request email/text after job completion (configurable delay: 1-7 days)
  • Personalized message based on project details
  • Multi-platform: Google, Yelp, Facebook (include direct links)
  • Track who was asked and who responded
  • Flag negative reviews for immediate attention Integration: Email/SMS API

24. Competitive Intel (Basic)

Trigger: "What's [competitor] doing?", "Compare us to [company]" Agent: Research What it does:

  • Monitor competitor websites for changes (pricing, services, team)
  • Google Alerts integration for competitor mentions
  • Quarterly competitive summary
  • Pricing comparison when available Integration: Web search, web monitoring AOM internal equivalent: .claude/skills/social-media-research/

Scale Skills (Scale Tier and Above, 8 Additional Skills)

These unlock at the Scale tier ($5,000/month). Power tools.

25. Multi-Channel Outreach

Trigger: "Run a campaign across [channels]..." Agent: Outreach What it does:

  • Coordinated email + LinkedIn + phone outreach sequences
  • Channel-specific messaging (formal email, casual LinkedIn, brief phone script)
  • Sequence logic: if no email reply in 3 days, trigger LinkedIn connection request
  • Batch limit: 100 contacts per campaign
  • A/B testing on subject lines and messages
  • Full campaign analytics Integration: Email API, LinkedIn API (when available), native CRM

26. Financial Dashboard

Trigger: "Show me the numbers", "How's revenue this month?" Agent: Finance What it does:

  • Revenue tracking (from invoices)
  • Expense tracking (from logged expenses)
  • Profit/loss by month
  • Cash flow projection (basic: based on outstanding invoices and recurring expenses)
  • Budget vs. actual by category
  • Exportable monthly P&L for CPA Integration: Native (aggregates from invoicing and expense skills)

27. Hiring/Recruitment Assistant

Trigger: "I need to hire a [role]", "Draft a job posting for..." Agent: HR What it does:

  • Generate job postings from role description
  • Post to job boards (Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs when API available)
  • Screen incoming applications against criteria
  • Schedule interviews via Calendar skill
  • Track candidate pipeline Integration: Email API, Calendar API, job board APIs (future)

28. Training Content Generator

Trigger: "Create training material for...", "New employee orientation for..." Agent: Content What it does:

  • Generate training documents from SOPs and knowledge base
  • Step-by-step procedure guides with screenshots (when provided)
  • Quiz generation for comprehension testing
  • Onboarding checklists for new hires
  • Multilingual output (English/Spanish for construction) Integration: Native document system

29. Permit and Compliance Tracker

Trigger: "Track permits for [project]", "What permits do we need for..." Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Track permit applications, status, and expiration dates
  • Renewal reminders (30/60/90 days before expiration)
  • Checklist of required permits by project type (configured per jurisdiction)
  • Document storage for permit copies
  • License expiration tracking (contractor license, insurance, bonding) Integration: Native, calendar for reminders Construction-specific: Pre-built checklists for Arizona ROC requirements

30. Vendor/Subcontractor Management

Trigger: "Add [company] as a subcontractor", "Who do we use for [specialty]?" Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Subcontractor and vendor database
  • Performance tracking (quality, timeliness, pricing)
  • Insurance/license expiration alerts
  • Preferred vendor lists by specialty
  • Cost comparison for common services Integration: Native, document storage for COIs

31. Automated Reporting

Trigger: "Generate weekly report", auto-scheduled weekly/monthly Agent: Operations What it does:

  • Customizable report templates (weekly operations, monthly financials, quarterly review)
  • Auto-pull data from all connected skills
  • Client-facing reports (branded PDF)
  • Internal reports (operations health, agent performance)
  • Email delivery to configurable recipients Integration: Native (aggregates from all skills)

32. Voice Command Interface

Trigger: Voice input via mobile PWA Agent: All (routes to correct agent based on content) What it does:

  • Accept voice commands from mobile
  • Transcribe and route to appropriate skill
  • "Hey Corner, schedule a site visit with John for Thursday at 2 PM"
  • "Hey Corner, how much did we invoice last month?"
  • Confirmation via voice response or text Integration: Whisper API (speech-to-text), native routing Why Scale tier: Requires additional API costs (Whisper) and mobile optimization

Enterprise-Only Skills

Available at $10,000+/month or as custom builds.

Custom Agent Development

Build agents specific to the client's business. Not from templates. From scratch, based on their unique workflows.

API Integration Hub

Connect Corner to any third-party system via custom API integrations. ServiceTitan, QuickBooks, Procore, Buildertrend, Housecall Pro, or any system with an API.

Multi-Location Management

Dashboard views across multiple offices/locations. Consolidated reporting. Location-specific agent configurations.

Compliance Automation

Industry-specific compliance workflows. OSHA reporting for construction. Tax deadline management for CPAs. Regulatory filing tracking.

White-Label Resale

Client can resell Corner to their own clients under their brand. Full white-label with custom domain, branding, and pricing.

Skill Card UI (For Steffen)

Each skill should have a visual card in the dashboard (visible in the Skills section of Megaboard mode and in the admin panel).

Card contents:

  • Skill icon (simple, monochrome, consistent style)
  • Skill name
  • One-line description
  • Category badge (Operations, Communications, Finance, Content, Sales, Research, HR, Platform)
  • Tier badge (Core, Growth, Scale, Enterprise)
  • Status indicator (Active, Available, Locked)
  • "Locked" skills show what tier is needed to unlock (upsell opportunity)

Design direction:

  • Card grid layout. 3-4 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile.
  • Clean, minimal. White cards on light gray background.
  • Hover state reveals full description.
  • Active skills have a subtle green accent. Locked skills are slightly dimmed.

Build Priority for Bobby

Phase 1 (C3): Core infrastructure

  1. Task Management (it IS the Checklist mode)
  2. Calendar Management
  3. Daily Briefing
  4. Status Report
  5. Reminder System
  6. Internal Knowledge Base

Phase 2 (C3 polish): Communication basics 7. Email Drafter 8. Client Follow-Up 9. Contact Management 10. Meeting Notes

Phase 3 (C4 launch): Full Core + Growth essentials 11-14. Remaining Core skills (Document Generator, Quick Research, Weather, Expense Tracking) 15-18. Growth headliners (Lead Pipeline, Estimate Generator, Scheduling Dispatch, Invoice Tracking)

Phase 4 (C4 polish): Growth + Scale 19-24. Remaining Growth skills 25-32. Scale skills

What This Catalog Is NOT

  • Not a technical implementation spec. Each skill needs its own SKILL.md with detailed instructions, edge cases, and integration details. This catalog defines WHAT ships and WHEN.
  • Not final. Skills will be added, modified, and re-tiered as we learn from real client usage.
  • Not a pricing document. Tier pricing is in the pricing page spec. This just maps skills to tiers.

32 skills at launch. 14 in Core, 24 in Growth, 32 in Scale. That's not a chatbot. That's a team. When Patrik says "Corner gives you a team of AI agents" and the prospect asks "what can they actually do?"... hand them this list.
